name: Oswaldo Guayasamín
contribution: An Ecuadorian painter and sculptor of Kichwa and Mestizo heritage.
legacy: He is still lauded as a national treasure and has been likened to the Michelangelo of Latin America by the Spanish art historian José Camón Aznar.

checks.lead: Oswaldo Guayasamín Calero (July 6, 1919 – March 10, 1999) was an Ecuadorian painter and sculptor of Kichwa and Mestizo heritage.
